Requirements for Degrees | Wake Forest University Academic Bulletin
sentence: All students must earn a minimum cumulative 2.0 grade point average (GPA) in Wake Forest College and the School of Business.

page_title: Requirements for Degrees | Wake Forest University Academic Bulletin
sentence: The student will have a minimum 2.0 cumulative GPA and a minimum 2.0 GPA in the major(s).

page_title: Requirements for Degrees | Wake Forest University Academic Bulletin
sentence: To become a degree candidate, a student must submit an application for program completion in Workday that will prompt a review of the student’s academic record to assure that all degree requirements have been met.

page_title: Requirements for Degrees | Wake Forest University Academic Bulletin
sentence: Students are not allowed to exempt divisional core requirements through the Advanced Placement (AP) Examination, the College Level Examination Program (CLEP), or the International Baccalaureate (IB) Program, although students who complete AP, CLEP, or IB courses and present qualifying exam scores earn credit towards the 120 hours needed for graduation.

If you are applying to college for the first time, transferring from another institution, coming from abroad, or returning to continue your education, you will find clear guidance on eligibility requirements, application procedures, and specialized admission options.
